Join a big ant investigation in the autumn satoyama (semi-wild grassland)! Ants are common creatures we see every day, but did you know there are many different species with surprisingly complex lives?

【Participation fee】
Adults: ¥5,000
Students: ¥4,000
Preschool children: ¥2,500
(Includes guide, insurance, and materials)

【Capacity】15 people

【Guide】Mori no Field Gakusha (Forest Field Learning Center) staff

【What to bring】Drinking water, rain gear, gloves, snacks, lunch, appropriate clothing for hiking (long sleeves, long pants, comfortable walking shoes)

【Notes】For more information, visit the Mori no Field Gakusha website: https://morinomanabiya168.wixsite.com/website
